correctness.rationale: The explicit full-branch inverse maps yield triangular polynomial transfer action with diagonal S_(m+1) on even m, (2p-1)S_(m+1) on odd m, and adjacent coefficient m C_m times parity factor. For each odd d, collision at p_d=(1+S_(d+2)/S_(d+1))/2 has nonzero coupling B_d=(d+1)q_d C_(d+1)>0, proved by comparing the j=2 positive summand to the j>=3 tail. Strict log-convexity of S makes distinct biases increase to 3/4 with stated asymptotic; shifted Legendre orthogonality projects out lower degrees, giving exact n*lambda^(n-1) annealed correlation. Independent convergent moment sums for d=1,3,5,7 confirmed p~0.724922,0.747782,0.749767,0.749974 and B_d>0.
residual_risks: Only invariant polynomial restrictions and annealed stationary correlations are proved. Not an isolated global transfer-operator eigenvalue theorem; finite moment truncations are diagnostics, not infinite spectral certificates.
